TOM_LB_01.organic_alternative: Neem oil spray (1500 PPM) @ 2.5 L/ha + Trichoderma viride 1% WP @ 2 kg/acre
dos_list: Maintain proper field drainage to prevent moisture accumulation
Apply protective fungicides during cloudy or humid weather conditions
Ensure uniform spray coverage on both upper and lower leaf surfaces
donts_list: Do not use overhead sprinkler irrigation during high humidity
Avoid excessive nitrogenous fertilizer applications
Do not leave infected crop residues in the field after harvest

TOM_ELB_01.organic_alternative: Foliar spray of Pseudomonas fluorescens 1% WP @ 1 kg/acre
dos_list: Prune lower infected leaves to improve air circulation
Mulch soil surface to prevent fungal spore splash-back
donts_list: Avoid handling wet plants during early morning hours
Do not plant solanaceous crops consecutively in the same field

COT_APH_01.organic_alternative: Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE) 5% or Neem Oil 1500 PPM @ 1 L/acre
dos_list: Install yellow sticky traps @ 10 traps per acre for early monitoring
Inspect the underside of young terminal leaves twice weekly
Maintain border crops like maize or sorghum to encourage beneficial insects
donts_list: Do not spray broad-spectrum chemical insecticides if ladybird beetles are present
Avoid water stress during early vegetative growth stages
Do not exceed recommended chemical concentrations to prevent pest resistance

dos_list: Install Pheromone traps @ 2 traps/acre for pest monitoring
Destroy rosette flowers showing internal larvae
donts_list: Avoid extending the cotton crop duration beyond 160 days
Do not stack crop residues near active fields

RIC_BLA_01.organic_alternative: Pseudomonas fluorescens 0.5% WP @ 1 kg/acre as seed treatment and foliar spray
dos_list: Use certified disease-resistant seed varieties
Maintain a 2 to 5 cm standing water level during the tillering stage
Apply nitrogenous fertilizers in split doses rather than a single heavy application
donts_list: Avoid heavy top-dressing of urea during overcast or cloudy weather
Do not allow the field to dry completely during the panicle initiation stage
Avoid using seeds from previously infected crop cycles

RIC_BLB_01.organic_alternative: Foliar spray of fresh cow dung extract 5% + Neem oil 1%
dos_list: Drain field water temporarily upon observing kresek symptoms
Ensure clean field channels to prevent waterborne bacteria spread
donts_list: Do not clip leaf tips during transplanting operations
Avoid excessive field flooding across infected plots

WHE_APH_01.organic_alternative: Spray Neem Oil (1500 PPM) @ 1 L/acre or release Chrysoperla carnea predators
dos_list: Monitor border rows early in the season for pest arrival
Spray during late afternoon hours to preserve natural pollinators
Balance crop nutrition using recommended NPK fertilizer ratios
donts_list: Do not perform chemical sprays if natural predator populations are high
Avoid late sowing of wheat crops which increases aphid vulnerability
Do not reuse chemical containers for storing farm inputs

WHE_YRU_01.organic_alternative: Foliar spray of bio-agent Bacillus subtilis @ 1 kg/acre
dos_list: Survey fields weekly during cool, moist winter conditions
Apply systemic fungicide immediately upon observing yellow pustule stripes
donts_list: Avoid growing susceptible varieties in sub-mountainous zones
Do not delay chemical sprays if rust spots spread across flags leaves

POT_EB_01.organic_alternative: Trichoderma viride @ 2 kg/acre soil application mixed with Farmyard Manure (FYM)
dos_list: Practice a 3-year crop rotation with non-solanaceous crops
Destroy and burn infected crop leaves and tubers after harvest
Apply protective sprays as soon as lower leaves show concentric ring spots
donts_list: Do not store harvested tubers in warm, unventilated rooms
Avoid physical tuber injury during harvesting and sorting
Do not irrigate fields immediately before harvesting

dos_list: Earthing up soil firmly to protect underground tubers from spores
Destroy haulms 10-12 days before harvest if late blight appears
donts_list: Do not harvest during wet weather conditions
Avoid using blighted seed tubers for planting

GKM_PDB_01.organic_alternative: HaNPV @ 100 LE/acre + 0.5% jaggery or Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) @ 400 g/acre
dos_list: Erect T-shaped bird perches @ 20 per acre for natural bird predation
Install Helicoverpa pheromone traps @ 5 traps per acre for early monitoring
Intercrop with coriander or mustard to attract beneficial parasitoids
donts_list: Do not delay spraying once egg laying or early instar larvae are observed
Avoid spraying during peak daylight hours when bees are foraging
Do not apply synthetic pyrethroids repeatedly to prevent resistance build-up

BRN_WHF_01.organic_alternative: Yellow sticky traps @ 15 traps/acre + Neem oil (10,000 PPM) @ 3 ml/L water
dos_list: Clean weeds and alternate hosts around field borders
Maintain proper plant spacing to allow ventilation and sunlight penetration
Use yellow sticky traps early in the cropping season
donts_list: Do not spray broad-spectrum insecticides close to harvest times
Avoid continuous monocropping of solanaceous vegetables in the same field
Do not exceed prescribed chemical application frequencies

MAI_FAW_01.organic_alternative: Apply whorl application of sand + neem cake mix (9:1 ratio)
dos_list: Apply insecticides directly into crop whorls using nozzle attachments
Deploy FAW pheromone traps @ 4 traps/acre upon sowing
donts_list: Do not use blanket foliar spray; target crop whorls directly
Avoid chemical applications when natural earwigs are abundant

SUG_BOR_01.organic_alternative: Release Trichogramma chilonis egg parasitoids @ 20,000/acre at 15-day intervals
dos_list: Apply granules in soil furrows during planting or early irrigation
Remove and destroy dead hearts showing borer entrance holes
donts_list: Do not allow field drying during early shoot growth
Avoid applying soil granules without immediate irrigation

SOY_RST_01.organic_alternative: Foliar spray of Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE) 5%
dos_list: Inspect lower leaves of canopy during flowering stage
Spray immediately at first appearance of tan lesions
donts_list: Do not plant high-density crops without adequate row spacing
Avoid overhead irrigation during flowering phase
